summary: Accepted after independent digest-bound re-review of the generator-ownership-only change. Each case now names a distinct AW-generated wrapper path, while every command, assertion, capability/claim binding, required dimension, and previously accepted product oracle is unchanged. The pre-generation absence of wrapper files is fail-closed and expected: commands still directly execute the real HTTP/Raft, HMAC-negative, release efficiency, and fixed-keyspace retry-soak gates, so wrapper ownership neither substitutes for nor weakens their independent pass/fail oracles.
